start: Android 14+ phone, member on Health Connect's permission screen for MettleUp

steps.action: Tap "Read MettleUp's privacy policy" (Health Connect's link)
must_not: MettleUp's home screen opens instead of the policy
A see-through screen stuck over Health Connect

start: Android 13 or older phone with the Health Connect app, MettleUp's permission screen
Phone with no browser installed (or the browser disabled)

steps.action: Tap the privacy policy link on Health Connect's screen
user_sees: Health Connect's screen stays as it was
must_not: A see-through screen that blocks taps

start: Member opened the policy once, came back, opened it again

steps.action: Tap the link a second time
user_sees: The policy again in the browser
must_not: A second MettleUp screen in Recents
MettleUp opening its own home screen

start: Member reads the policy from Health Connect's link

steps.action: Scroll to the Health Connect part
user_sees: Words that Health Connect data never goes to the gym, to advertisers or to any AI
must_not: A different policy from the one in the Play Console
A page that does not mention Health Connect
